label: SLA Performance Analyzer
description: Analyzes service level agreement performance data. Identifies breaches, near-misses, trends, and root causes. Produces SLA health report with improvement recommendations.

claudeKnowledge.description: Service level management, SLA frameworks, operational performance best practices

options.label: Vendor / supplier SLA (we are the customer)
Client SLA (we are the service provider)
Regulatory service standard (e.g., complaint handling timeframes)

guidedInputs.label: SLA performance data
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Paste your SLA performance data. For each SLA metric include: metric name, target, actual performance, number of breaches, and any context.

Example:
Ticket resolution time: Target <4 hours, Actual avg 5.2 hours, 23 breaches in period
System availability: Target 99.9%, Actual 99.4%, 3 outage events
Complaint response: Target <5 days, Actual avg 6.8 days, 12 breaches

guidedInputs.label: Additional context
guidedInputs.placeholder: Any operational events, staffing changes, system issues, or other factors relevant to SLA performance.
